title: Each brush shows its own settings in the tool options and the panel, and each one visibly changes the stroke
goal: While the brush is in hand, the options over the tool bar let you pick the medium from a dropdown and set its size, opacity and its own settings, the way Procreate and Photoshop brushes each have their own, and the panel shows the full list. The brush remembers its settings per medium.
notes:
Umbrella: a-brush-tool-paints-with-realistic-charcoal-chal (the user's ask, 2026-10-24). Design: docs/design/brushes.md, read it first; its decisions are settled unless this task's runner finds one cannot work, in which case they say so in the log and in the doc.

Design doc decision 7. Read the settings list from BrushMedium in PhotonzCore, never a second list in the app. Placement contract: tool options capsule + panel section are the two allowed doors. More than three exclusive options is a dropdown. Panel rows are labels and values, no sentences.
acceptance: The tool options over the tool bar show a Medium dropdown with the seven media, Size, Opacity and the medium's own two main settings, all with plain names; the panel's Brush section shows every setting for the medium
Changing a setting changes the next stroke and never repaints strokes already made; each medium remembers its own values
[ and ] shrink and grow the brush, and a size ring under the pointer shows the tip size
Every control is proven clickable at a point on its face by a walk with no flags; a sheet of strokes per setting goes in the audit

log.note: deps set by the umbrella's planning run: pressing-b-picks-a-brush-that-paints-freehand-st

From charcoal-chalk-and-crayon-catch-on-a-paper-grain (2026-10-24): the tool options capsule already carries Medium (a dropdown of all seven, ToolSetting.brushMedium) and Mode (Paint | Smudge, ToolSetting.brushMode) so the dry-media walk could reach chalk and crayon. This task adds Size, Opacity and the medium's own two after them, the panel section, per-medium memory, and the pointer-face proof for the Medium dropdown.

The user, 2026-10-24: wants 'a better chooser than a dropdown without previewing'. The Medium dropdown in this task's first acceptance item is superseded by brushes-are-picked-from-a-library-of-tiles-that (seq 6.45, built to brush-library.html): do NOT build or keep the dropdown. This task keeps per-brush settings, the panel's full list, the size ring and [ ]. The user also said each brush should have knobs specific to it ('airbrush might have some about the spray intencity or spread'): every medium's own settings must be the ones that medium needs, each visibly changing the stroke.

Pencil (added 2026-10-24) has three own settings: Hardness (a choice of grades 4H..8B, options in BrushSettingSpec, so a dropdown), Grain, Tilt Shading. The medium test now allows more than two own settings; the capsule should carry Hardness and Grain, the panel all three.

From the marker and airbrush slice (2026-10-25): the engine already honours the marker's Tip (Round or Chisel, two options so a segmented control) and Flow, and the airbrush's Flow and Softness; they only need controls. The sheet in queue/audits/2026-10-25-marker-airbrush-sheet.png shows what each does. Also: Size carries over on a medium switch, so an airbrush picked after a 14 pt marker paints a thin line; per-medium remembered values (this task's second checklist item) fixes that.

Watercolour now has three own settings (Wetness, Bleed, Granulation; 2026-10-25), so its capsule row has one more than the 'two own settings' the design doc assumed; the panel carries all three. Same as the pencil's three.

From the airbrush slice (2026-10-25): the airbrush's own settings are now Flow, Spread, Droplet Size, Build-up (four, Softness became Spread with the old id mapped). The capsule should carry Flow and Spread, the panel all four. Sheets: queue/audits/2026-10-25-airbrush-*.png.
owns these walks: each-brush-shows-its-own-settings-walk, brush-settings-on-a-click-walk, brushes-picked-from-tiles-walk

Review before building: a Photoshop user expects Size/Opacity/Flow on the options bar and [ ] for size (built); a Procreate user expects each brush to remember its own size (built, AnnotationStyles brush memory). Mock gap: brush-library.html Properties shows values only, this task's checklist asks for controls; the mock's Do buttons belong to make-your-own-brushes-a-custom-group-a-brush-fil.

Chose the first two of each medium's own settings for the tool options over a per-medium hand-picked pair because the settings list is already ordered most-used first (pencil Hardness+Grain, airbrush Flow+Spread as the notes asked).

Chose Mode (Paint/Smudge) to follow the brush across media, and every other value to be remembered per medium, because smudging with another medium is one step (decision 7) while a size belongs to the brush.

Chose to put [ and ] on the window (zero-size buttons in the tool options, like the tool bar's letters) as well as in Edit > Tools: a walk's window is never key, so the menu has no editor there; a person gets the same command either way.

Measured bar (BrushSettingsVisibleTests): each own setting's two ends differ over >= 0.2 of the stroke. Before: charcoal Smudge 0.08 failed; strengthened at the top end (defaults within a tenth), now 0.47. Pictures looked at: all eight sheets (every row changes across its three strokes; Tilt with a leaning pen, Smear over red, Build-up held), the three walk captures and the marker tip capture.

Review after building: the options row is wide (~1080 pt) and wraps on narrow windows; the panel's brush rows are named 'Brush <name>' for walks and accessibility, apart from the picked paint layer's own Opacity row.

left rough: the size ring is a cursor image, capped at 250 screen points, so a very big brush at high zoom shows a smaller ring than its tip. Not filed: rare; fold into the painting-speed slice if it comes up.

Tool options carry Brush, Mode, Size, Opacity and the brush's first two own settings; the panel's Brush section has every setting as a control; each medium remembers its values; [ and ] step size (window + Edit > Tools) and the ring redraws. Verified: 14,568 tests green incl. BrushSettingsControlsTests and BrushSettingsVisibleTests (every own setting changes >= 0.2 of the stroke; charcoal Smudge strengthened 0.08 -> 0.47); walks each-brush-shows-its-own-settings-walk (no flags, pointer presses on sliders/segments in both places) and brush-settings-on-a-click-walk (Hardness dropdowns clicked at centre/start/end) plus all brush and tool-settings walks pass. Audit queue/audits/2026-10-25-brush-settings.json with per-brush sheets. Commit 5262f1d1.
